incident-autopilot-worker-throttling.description: Worker Lambda is throttling — reserved concurrency is too low for current load

incident-autopilot-dlq-depth.description: Messages have exhausted retries and landed in the dead-letter queue. Redriving unknown poison messages automatically risks an infinite retry loop, so this always goes to a human.

incident-autopilot-permission-failure.description: Worker Lambda hit an AccessDenied error. Permission issues are never auto-remediated — automatically 'fixing' IAM is itself a security risk.
